content: Řmewt n Nadab d Abihu
Nadab d Abihu, arraw n Harun, ksin kuř ijj řmejmar nnes uca ggin dayes řebxur uca ammu i yiwyen nitni timessi teɣrib zzat i wudem n SIDI, min war d asen iweṣṣa Netta.
Teffeɣ-dd tmessi zi zzat i wudem n SIDI, tecc i-ten uca mmuten zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Inna Musa i Harun: “D man aya x min xef issiweř SIDI umi inna: ‘S yinni i ɣari dd ɣa iqarrben ad ttwaqeddseɣ uca zzat i wudem n marra řgens ad ttwassɛuǧeɣ.’” Uca isqar Harun.
Iřaɣa Musa i Micayil d i Ilṣafan, arraw n Ɛuzziyil, ɛemmis n Harun, uca inna asen: “Qarrbem-dd, tarbum aytmatwem zi qibač n Zzawect Iqeddsen, awyi ten barra i řmargeḥ n řɛeskar.”
Qarrben-dd nitni uca arbun ten di tcamirat nsen barra i řmargeḥ n řɛeskar, am mammec t inna Musa.

Xenni inna Musa i Harun u i Aliɛazar d Itamar, arraw nnes: “War ḍeǧqem i ucuwwaf x izeǧifen nwem niɣ ttcarrgem arruḍ nwem i wecḍan, ḥima war tᵉttmettim uca ad yiři uduqqez n weɣḍab x marra tamesmunt. Maca aytmatwem, marra taddart n Israil, ad run x tmessi-ya, tenni issecmeḍ SIDI.
War dd-tteffɣem ca zi wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar, ḥima war tᵉttmettim ca, minzi zzect n wedhan n SIDI aqa tt xawem.” Uca nitni ṭṭaɛen i wawař n Musa.
Tawṣeyyet x binu d ccrab
Issiweř SIDI ak-d Harun, inna:

“War iɛeddeř ad tsessed binu niɣ ccrab ijehden xmi ɣa tadfem ɣar Uqiḍun n Umsagar, cek lla uřa d iḥenjiren nnec nni akidek lla, ḥima war tᵉttmettim ca. Aqa-tt d ict n tewṣeyyet i řebda i marra jjiřat nwem,
ḥima ad af tzemmarem ad tfarzem jar min iǧan iqeddsen d min war iǧin iqeddsen u jar min iṣfan d min war iṣfin,
u ḥima ad tessřemdem i ayt n Israil marra tiweṣṣa nni ɣarsen issiweř SIDI s tsexxart n Musa.”
Aliɛazar d Itamar

Uca issiweř Musa ak-d Harun u ak-d Aliɛazar d Itamar, arraw nnes iqqimen: “Ksim tawhibt n řɣiǧet nni iceṭṭen zi tewhibin n tmessi i SIDI uca ccem tt břa antun zzat i uɛalṭar, minzi aqa-tt d tamqeddast qaɛ.
Ad tt teccem deg ijj n wemcam iqeddsen, minzi ta d taɣarṣt i cek u i iḥenjiren nnec zi tewhibin n tmessi n SIDI, minzi ammu i d ayi ittwaweṣṣa.

Deg ijj n wemcan iṣfa ad teccem ɛawed idmaren n wenhezzi d ucekrud n tewhibt i dd-ittwassgeɛɛden, cek d iḥenjiren nnec d tḥenjirin nnec akidek, minzi d man aya d tasɣart nnec d tasɣart n tarwa nnec zi tɣarṣa n řehna n ayt n Israil.

Ad awyen acekrud n tewhibt i dd-ittwassgeɛɛden uřa d idmaren n wenhezzi ak-d tewhibin n tmessi n tadunt, maḥend ad ten ssenhezzen zzat i wudem n SIDI am tewhibt n wenhezzi. Aqa d ict n tewṣeyyet i řebda i cek u i iḥenjiren nnec akidek, am mammec t iweṣṣa SIDI.”
Uca Musa yarzu s cḍaret x umyan n tɣarṣt n ddenb, maca xzar, icemḍ. Xenni iffugem x Aliɛazar d Itamar, arraw iqqimen n Harun, inna:

“Mayemmi war teccim taɣarṣt n ddenb deg wemcan iqeddsen? Minzi aqa-tt d tamqeddast qaɛ uca netta iwca awem tt-i-dd ḥima kenniw ad tarbum řmuɛṣiyyet n tmesmunt, maḥend ad xasen teggem aṣřaḥ zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Xzarem, ḥdam war ssidfen walu zeg idammen daxeř i Zzawect Iqeddsen. Tuɣa ittxeṣṣa kenniw ad tt teccem di Zzawect Iqeddsen am mammec d awem weṣṣiɣ necc.”

Xenni issiweř Harun ak-d Musa: “Xzar, ass-a aqa qeddmen taɣarṣt n ddenb d tɣarṣt n wecmaḍ zzat i wudem n SIDI. Mařa necc, awarni řami xafi kkent tmesřayin-a, aqa cciɣ zi tɣarṣt n ddenb ass-a, ma xenni man aya icna di tiṭṭawin n SIDI?”
Umi isřa Musa aya, iban as-dd man aya d lemliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnes.
